title: nan
authors: Wang Z.; Shen X.; Li J.; Li J.; Wu X.; Yang Y.
key_contribution: Presents a self-attention LSTM hybrid network (SALSTM) to enhance integrated navigation for small UAVs in GNSS-denied environments, validated with field-test flight data and accuracy improvements.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using Deep_Learning_Odometry to ensure precise positioning.
